title: Sekki: the photo food diary that takes one snap before you eat
description: Snap one photo before you eat and Sekki files it under breakfast, lunch or dinner. One meal a day keeps your streak alive, and friends cheer each other on.

hero.headline:
One photo before you eat.
That's the whole log.
hero.lead: Sekki looks at when you took the photo and files it under breakfast, lunch, dinner or a snack. Log just one meal a day and your streak keeps going.
hero.cta: Get it free on the App Store
hero.note: Logging, stats, widgets and sharing with friends are all free.

demo.title: Try logging a meal
demo.lead: Pick a time and tap the log button. Just like in the app, the button already names the meal for that time.
demo.kept: One meal is enough. Today counts toward your streak.
demo.rule: Same rules as the app: 5 to 10 a.m. is breakfast, 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. is lunch, 4 to 9 p.m. is dinner. Any other time, or a meal you already logged, goes in as a snack.
demo.note: The photos in this demo are examples.

problem.title: Ever quit a food diary after three days?
problem.text: Skip breakfast once, forget dinner twice, and the empty boxes start nagging until you delete the app. Sekki has no empty boxes. Only the meals you log stack up in order, and a single photo makes the day count.

features.title: Snap it, and the meal is sorted
features.text:
Sekki files each photo under breakfast, lunch, dinner or a snack based on when you took it. Add before and after photos, log without a photo, or jot down a note.
It recognizes the food on your device, for free, and your photos never leave your phone.

features.title: A log that never shrinks
features.text:
One meal a day keeps your streak alive, and your total days logged never go down. Weekly and monthly stats show how many days and meals you logged instead of a completion score.
Achievements like 7-Day Streak and Early Bird pile up along the way.

features.title: Only the meals you choose, without opening the app
features.text:
Pick which meals you want reminders for and set times that fit your day. Take a before photo and you can mark the meal finished right from the notification.
Log with the Action button, Siri, Shortcuts or a Home Screen widget, and add friends by code to cheer each other on with emojis and comments.

items.title: Choose your meals
items.text: The first time you open Sekki, it asks which meals to remind you about. Change them anytime in Settings.

items.title: Snap before you eat
items.text: The log button already shows the meal for the current time. Tap it, take the photo, done.

items.title: Tap when you're done
items.text: Hit Finished in the notification or widget, or add an after photo.

pricing.note: Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Cancel anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. Terms of Service: m1zz.github.io/RoutineCamera/en/terms.html

items.a: On your device. Turn on Save to Photos Automatically in Settings to also keep them in the Sekki albums in Photos. While Share My Meals is on (it's on at first), they're uploaded to iCloud so the friends you add can see them. You can turn it off in Settings > Account & Sharing.
On the Friends screen, share your six-character friend code and enter your friend's code. You can paste several codes at once, separated by commas.

items.q: How do I cheer on a friend?
items.a: Open a friend's meal and leave an emoji or a short comment. If they haven't logged a meal yet, tap the empty slot to send a gentle nudge.

items.q: Does missing a meal break my streak?
items.a: No. Log any one meal that day, snacks included, and the streak continues. Even if you skip a whole day, your total days logged never go down.
Check that notifications are allowed for Sekki in iOS Settings > Notifications, and that your device is signed in to iCloud. You can change your meal reminder times in the app's Settings.

items.q: Does food analysis send my photos to a server?
items.a: No. It runs on your device, so your photos never leave your phone. It's free with no limit.

items.q: How do I delete my account and data?
items.a: Go to Friends > Account > Delete Account. Your account and the meal data stored on the server are deleted and can't be recovered. If anything goes wrong, just email us.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: In Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Lifetime is a single charge.
